name: Marble Mirage
source:
A weekend at an exclusive men’s spa, Marble House, goes awry when a gruesome discovery is made.
Snow seals you inside a luxurious men’s spa. A guest is dead. Your memory is fractured. Among six alluring men, one may be the killer.
Eight men entered Marble House. One is dead. With six romance options remaining, every bond you form could lead to passion – or peril. Could your memories hold the key to unlocking the mystery?
